results.title: A bigger BRICS, shaped by India’s vision
results.description: The bigger picture remains that of the BRICS grouping living up to its full potential and the Delhi BRICS Summit ought to make concrete progress towards that end

results.title: Hikmat Hajiyev: Azerbaijan and Mexico have great potential for partnership
results.description: Azerbaijan and Mexico have significant potential for close partnership and cooperation within international organizations, Hikmat Hajiyev, Assistant to the President of Azerbaijan and Head of the Foreign Policy Affairs Department of the Presidential Administration, said at a reception marking Mexico's Independence Day.
